items.title: Version 0.5.28-demo2
items.body: New: A whole new look (Settings › Themes): textbox styles (Rounded, Notebook, real frosted Glass, Minimal), decorations (Clouds, Sky, Petals, Sparkles), main menu layouts, a new pause menu (Esc) and icon buttons you can put in five places; Choices and History match your textbox (click a History line to rewind there), and rewind is on: the Back icon or the mouse wheel; Extras › Chapters: start again from any act you've reached, and Route select after you finish Act 6; "Story so far": a short recap when you load a save; Seen choices get a tick, and a new button skips to the next choice; Poem hints after your first clear: a heart in the colour of the girl who loves each word; Gentle content notes before Sayori's heaviest scenes (Settings › Game › Help turns them off); Phone wallpapers (any CG you've seen) and stickers you can send in chats; Achievements: hints for the secret ones, progress bars and a prettier pop-up; Autosave on every choice, F5 / F9 quick save and load, F12 for a screenshot without the textbox; Launcher 1.8: a News tab with updates, devlogs and sneak peeks, beta codes and one-click mod installs; Android: beta codes (Settings › Player › Beta). Fixed: The icons under the textbox hiding with the "On hover" position; Dark themes: the name, pronoun and look windows are easy to read; Switching back to the Original theme puts every menu back exactly the way DDLC had it.

items.title: Patch 0.5.1: Hina has a face! 🌸
items.body:
Thank you for all the reports in #bug-reports and #general. Patch 0.5.1 is out:

**New**
• Hina finally has a sprite! (art by Storm Blaze, thank you!!)
• New "Your Look" sprites: a boy and a girl in DDLC's own style (by Storm Blaze and u/shidodraws), with a picker that shows pictures in Settings
• The phone is dark mode again by default (Settings › Themes › Phone)

**Fixed**
• Stuck on the ending card after the Party Pooper ending
• Hina's homework photo in the group chat is no longer a blank page
• Launcher 1.3: easier "Locate DDLC" (pick ddlc-win.zip or DDLC.exe), sharper text on scaled screens, a scrollbar on What's new

**How to update:** Windows: open the DDSD launcher and press **Update**. Android: tap **Update available** on the main menu. Your saves are kept.
Download / changelog: https://aoi-doki.github.io/ddsd/

items.title: Version 0.5.2-demo2
items.body: New: Mod Hub in the launcher: browse community DDLC mods and install them in one click, or share your own (every mod is virus-scanned and checked by hand first); Menu sounds: Settings › Menu Sounds (DDLC, Chime, Pop or Music box); Saves on every device: Save/Load › Upload Sync gives you a code, type it on your other PC or phone with Download Sync. Fixed: The classroom has a chalkboard, not a whiteboard; Doki-colour chat bubbles are easier to see on the light phone; Removed a leftover "Uncensored Mode" option from the mod template (DDSD never had any such content). Launcher 1.5: New Mods tab: My mods, Browse (the Mod Hub), Share a mod, Report.

items.title: Demo 2 is out! 🌸 Acts 1 to 6, on Windows AND Android
items.body:
The whole common route is playable now: from your first day in the club all the way to the festival fireworks. Who will you watch them with?

**Download (free):** https://github.com/Aoi-doki/ddsd-releases/releases/latest
**How to install (with an Android guide):** https://aoi-doki.github.io/ddsd/install.html

**Windows:** grab `DDSD-Setup.exe`. It installs the game, finds your DDLC files, and keeps everything updated. (If Windows says "protected your PC": More info → Run anyway.)
**Android:** grab `DDSD.apk`. On first launch tap **PC** and pick the `ddlc-win.zip` you downloaded from ddlc.moe. The app updates itself from now on.
**Mac / Linux:** `ddsd-game.zip`, then copy DDLC's audio/fonts/images.rpa into its game folder.

**New in Demo 2**
• Act 5 (Festival Prep) and Act 6 (The Festival), and a new member: Hina
• You're in the club photo now: pick your look!
• Monika's own piano piece, real lighting, a bigger phone with chat bubbles in each girl's colour
• Text size slider, choice button styles, and a LOT of playtester fixes. Thank you all ♥

You need the original DDLC (free at ddlc.moe), and please finish it first. Work in progress: everything is subject to change. Bugs → #bug-reports!

items.title: ☔ Devlog: Rain Season, and a much longer game
items.body:
**Chapter 4 "Rain Season" is written!** A rainy week in June that ends in a storm nobody can walk home through. 🌧️
• A letter that really, *really* didn't want to stay in a shoe locker
• A rumour that goes round the whole school
• Every night, **all four girls text you**, and whoever you answer changes how the next morning starts
• For the first time, the game shows you a scene **you're not in** 👀
• Romance is officially in bloom 💕 (no spoilers, but some of you are going to scream)

**Chapters 1–3 got about 3× longer.** You asked for more, so the club talks more: class notes from Sayori, a clubroom tour, a rhyme debate where *you* break the tie, staying after club to help someone tidy up, a festival brainstorm, Natsuki's secret cupcake pitch, Yuri's fear of reading out loud, and a lot more. Every scene you liked is still there, word for word.

**New stuff**
🏆 6 new achievements (a couple of them secret)
💬 A **Join the club on Discord** button on the main menu and on your Rich Presence card
📖 New **#chapter-feedback** forum: one post per chapter, spoilers allowed inside
🐛 **#bug-reports** and 💡 **#suggestions** now have tags

**Next:** chapter 5, Festival Prep. 🎪
